comment: Both breakpoint jacks carry the maker's tooltip Wave CV, Osc5.cpp:92 and Osc5.cpp:95, which is the same name on two different jacks. Their attenuators run 0 to 0.1, Osc5.cpp:93 and Osc5.cpp:96, so a tenth of a breakpoint per volt is the most a cable can move. The breakpoint sums are fractions of a cycle rather than voltages, which is why the sumRange fields read that way.
